title: The function's value is attainable
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f\colon\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, let $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$. Then $f(x)$ can be attained by an input agreeing with $x$ at every coordinate outside $J$.
